cr_data.provenance: (An American Place, New York, NY); Mr. and Mrs. Herbert Morris, Mt. Airy, Pennsylvania, 1931/1932; (Makler Gallery, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania); Kennedy Galleries, Inc., New York, NY, and New House, New York, NY, 1974 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "New Mexican Landscape (Near Alcalde) – 1931" ["(Near Alcalde) – 1931" not verified]. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Note: Probably bought in 1931. From AARC Questionnaire.[American Art Research Council Questionnaires]" Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1931. Dated 1930 on basis of verso inscription, inclusion in 1931 New York (An American Place) exhibition, and Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence; pictured in Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 46. See cat. no. 1962. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Sandhills with Blue River

description: Smooth tan and pink sand hills ripple across landscape. A river running through the foreground glows blue, reflecting the bright blue sky overhead.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
